{
  "topics": [
    {
      "name": "UX Copywriting",
      "keyTerminology": [
        "Microcopy",
        "Error messages",
        "Empty states",
        "Call-to-action (CTA)",
        "Progressive disclosure",
        "Voice and tone",
        "Onboarding flows",
        "Tooltips",
        "Confirmation messages"
      ],
      "category": "discipline",
      "conventions": [
        "Prioritize clarity and usability over cleverness.",
        "Use active voice and front-load important information."
      ],
      "description": "The craft of writing intuitive interface copy that guides users through a digital experience seamlessly and efficiently."
    },
    {
      "name": "Content Design",
      "keyTerminology": [
        "Information architecture",
        "User needs",
        "Content modeling",
        "Readability",
        "Journey mapping",
        "Task completion",
        "Content audits",
        "Taxonomy",
        "Wireframing"
      ],
      "category": "discipline",
      "conventions": [
        "Design content as a structural component of the interface rather than an afterthought.",
        "Use data and research to answer user questions exactly when they arise."
      ],
      "description": "The strategic process of using data and evidence to give users the information they need, exactly when they need it, in the most optimal format."
    },
    {
      "name": "Monetization & Conversion UX",
      "keyTerminology": [
        "Friction points",
        "Conversion rate optimization (CRO)",
        "Persuasive design",
        "Pricing tiers",
        "Value proposition",
        "Dark patterns",
        "Scarcity",
        "Social proof",
        "Upselling flows"
      ],
      "category": "intersecting",
      "conventions": [
        "Balance business objectives with user trust and autonomy.",
        "Highlight value clearly without resorting to deceptive or manipulative dark patterns."
      ],
      "description": "The intersection of user experience and business goals, focusing on optimizing interfaces to encourage user action, purchases, subscriptions, or upgrades."
    },
    {
      "name": "AI Translation & Localization",
      "keyTerminology": [
        "Internationalization (i18n)",
        "Localization (l10n)",
        "Cultural nuances",
        "Machine translation",
        "Transcreation",
        "String length constraints",
        "Right-to-left (RTL) layout",
        "Translation memory"
      ],
      "category": "intersecting",
      "conventions": [
        "Provide contextual clues and glossaries for automated or human translation.",
        "Design interface components to accommodate text expansion or contraction across languages."
      ],
      "description": "Adapting digital products for different languages and cultures, increasingly utilizing artificial intelligence to scale global accessibility."
    },
    {
      "name": "AI Writing Assistance",
      "keyTerminology": [
        "Prompt engineering",
        "Generative AI",
        "Large Language Models (LLMs)",
        "Automated content generation",
        "Dynamic text replacement",
        "Personalization algorithms",
        "Human-in-the-loop (HITL)"
      ],
      "category": "intersecting",
      "conventions": [
        "Utilize AI as a drafting and ideation co-pilot, not a final arbiter of copy.",
        "Always enforce a human review process to ensure empathy, contextual accuracy, and brand alignment."
      ],
      "description": "The integration of large language models and artificial intelligence tools to augment the writing process, generate ideas, and scale content production."
    },
    {
      "name": "User Psychology & Cognitive Load",
      "keyTerminology": [
        "Cognitive load",
        "Hick's Law",
        "Mental models",
        "Paradox of choice",
        "Recognition over recall",
        "Gestalt principles",
        "F-pattern scanning",
        "Decision fatigue"
      ],
      "category": "intersecting",
      "conventions": [
        "Reduce cognitive friction by breaking complex tasks into smaller, manageable steps.",
        "Leverage familiar interaction patterns to align with users' existing mental models."
      ],
      "description": "The study of how users perceive, process, and act on information, applied to minimize mental effort in digital interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "Accessibility & Inclusive Design",
      "keyTerminology": [
        "WCAG guidelines",
        "Screen readers",
        "Alt text",
        "Plain language",
        "Neurodiversity",
        "Cognitive accessibility",
        "Semantic HTML",
        "Color contrast"
      ],
      "category": "intersecting",
      "conventions": [
        "Write in plain, accessible language, aiming for a broad reading comprehension level.",
        "Structure content with clear, descriptive headings to aid screen reader navigation."
      ],
      "description": "The practice of ensuring digital copy and content structures are usable by everyone, regardless of physical ability, neurodiversity, or background."
    }
  ]
}
